'''Echo Eleven''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Echo Flight]], a [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]].

During the first phase of the [[Battle at TFP-9]] the ship took some damage from [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. Soon the enemies were reinforced by unknown  [[Droid starfighter/Legends|Droid]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which destroyed Echo Eleven, as [[Rhys Dallows]] later reported.<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref><ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>
